request.prompt: A creature sprite for RimWorld: the runyip. A squat forest herbivore from Yavin 4 with branching antlers and a flexible snout. Dark brown stripes cross its pale coat, and its front toes bear claws. Visible features it must show: squat, low-slung body on short legs with a rounded hump of shoulders rising above the rump; the head hangs low on a short neck, so the downturned snout tip nearly reaches the ground; the snout is a shorter, thicker tapir-like proboscis, a broad flexible downturned pig/tapir snout in a pale muzzle with natural skin folds and a clearly defined, heavy thick lower lip beneath it; branching antlers; clawed toes on the front feet instead of hooves; pale coat crossed by bold dark brown stripes. Side view shows the profile with the shoulder hump and the low-hung head; front view shows the face with the broad pale snout and heavy lower lip, eyes toward the viewer. Realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite style, clean dark outline, soft painted edges in a deeper shade of the local colour. Exactly ONE creature, centred, the whole body visible with nothing cut off. Fully transparent background: no ground, no water, no shadow, no text, no border.
